title: finding(plugin-detail): RelatedToolbarButton renders a list_toolbar action authored visible: false; the gate reads the predicate by truthiness (the objectui#3812 declared-gate class)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction through the real component (class a). Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat. Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) from the objectui#11212 dev report (`5915507971`, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`), escalated by the at-tier review of PR objectui#11237 (`5915761337` ③: "I read it as deserving a carrier rather than none"). ⛔ Not graded here.
Dedup: objectui#3812 (closed `completed`) fixed the same class on `action:group` / `action:menu` members ("同一真值可见性门在动作面上未收口 —— 成员动作声明 `visible: false` 照样渲染"); this is a surface that fix did not reach. The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs carry no card for `RelatedToolbarButton` and `visible: false`.

## The defect

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` (objectui `origin/main`): `if (visiblePred && !isVisible) return null;` (about `:438`). A literal `visible: false` is falsy, so the gate is skipped and the button renders. `RelatedRecordActionsBridge`'s `deriveActions` passes `visible` through unfiltered.
- The rest of the action family decides "is a gate declared?" with `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate`, so a literal `false` hides and an empty string is no gate (objectui#3812 / objectui#3842).

## Measured

The objectui#11212 dev, with a throwaway probe through the real `RelatedToolbarButton` (jsdom, not committed): a `list_toolbar` action with `visible: false` read **SHOWN**. Not measured through a running console; the public door is a `record:related_list` block whose toolbar action is authored `visible: false`.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Use `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate` for the gate test, as the objectui#3812 family does, with a pin for `visible: false` (hidden), `visible: ''` (no gate) and a CEL string (evaluated). PR objectui#11237 made the same leg fail closed on a fault, and this is the one path it leaves open.

Dedupe words: `RelatedToolbarButton visible false renders` · `visiblePred truthiness related list toolbar` · `3812 declared gate RelatedList`
